notes: Company overview: mid-sized omnichannel retail platform (D2C + marketplace) operating EU + NA + LATAM. Heavy seasonal spikes (Black Friday, Cyber Week) — reliability during spikes is non-negotiable.
Primary pain: agents overloaded during peak windows; inconsistent translations and tone across locales lead to CS escalations and NPS drops.
Desired solution: multilingual agent-assist + real-time translation, ticket summarization for handoffs, tool-calling (create/update orders, refund workflows), and routing by locale + SLA tier.
Latency/throughput targets: avg API latency < 250ms for short-turn prompts (agent-assist), sustained throughput 2k requests/sec during spikes, tail p99 < 600ms.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for dedicated capacity during peaks but wants cost controls (autoscaling + burst + Optimize recommendations).
Model preferences: open-model family preferred; fallback to smaller quantized models for non-critical summarization tasks; ability to pin model versions for audits.
Security: must support customer-managed KMS, audit logs pushed to SIEM, SSO via SAML, and data residency in EU for EU-origin traffic.
Integration notes: legacy IVR + Genesys contact center; need webhook/tool-calling adapters for order-system (internal microservice) — engineering estimate ~3-4 sprint effort.
Quote from Head of CS: 'We need consistent, locale-appropriate responses — Latin America gets a different tone than Spain. If the tech can do that reliably at scale, it's a game-changer.'
POC scope: 6-week POC: 1) agent-assist plugin to Genesys frames, 2) batch ticket summarization for backlog, 3) regional routing + failover policy test, 4) security review and SSO test.
Success metrics: reduce average first response time by 30%, 40% fewer escalations on translated tickets, summary accuracy > 85% vs human label, stable throughput during synthetic spike tests.
Risks called out: network egress costs if routed cross-region, potential latency from on-prem proxy architecture, data retention terms in marketplace sellers' contracts.
Integration ask: sample SDK snippet for tool-calls (createRefund, escalateToSupervisor) and example eval set for Spanish (MX) vs Spanish (ES) tone tests.
